W_T = rng.normal(0.0, np.sqrt(T), n_paths)
S_T = S0*np.exp((mu-0.5*sigma**2)*T + sigma*W_T)
np.log(S_T/S0).mean()
# matches (mu - 0.5*sigma**2)*T,
# NOT the naive guess mu*T
caption: The Itô correction term shows up directly in simulated log-returns.
